ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota Human Services System Overhaul
ideas.description: This story would investigate the proposed overhaul of Minnesota's human services system, including its potential to combat fraud and improve services. It would examine the system's current issues, the proposed solutions, and the potential challenges and benefits of the overhaul.
questions: What are the current issues with the Minnesota human services system?
How will the proposed overhaul address these issues?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with the Minnesota human services system and to shed light on the proposed overhaul. It could also provide insight into the challenges and benefits of implementing such a large-scale change.
